WatchHistoryEmpty: The watch history file is empty.
WatchHistoryDisabled: Enable --save-watch-history to jump to recently played files.
SettingsHelpThumbnailSize: Width of the seek-bar preview thumbnail. Applies the next time the preview initializes, e.g. after reopening a file.
SettingsHelpThumbnailInterval: How often the preview refreshes while hovering, in milliseconds. Larger values save CPU on big files.
SettingsHelpPiPOpacity: Opacity of the picture-in-picture window (0.2-1.0). Applies the next time it opens.
SettingsHelpPiPTopButtons: Show the back and exit buttons when the pointer moves to the top of the mini-player.
SettingsHelpPiPControls: Show the control bar (volume, play, seek) when the pointer moves to the bottom of the mini-player.
SettingsHelpWindowAspectRatioLock: Keep the video aspect ratio while drag-resizing the window.
SettingsHelpAutoWindowResize: Resize window on video resolution change.
SettingsHelpAdLavcDownmix: Downmix multichannel audio to stereo at decoder level.
PanelAbHint: Set A then B to loop that range.
SettingsHelpAudioSpdif: Pass compressed audio (AC3/EAC3/DTS/TrueHD) through to the receiver without decoding. Leave Off for normal PCM output.
SettingsHelpReplaygain: Apply ReplayGain loudness normalization. Track uses per-track, Album uses per-album gain tags.
SettingsHelpOsdLevel: Amount of OSD information mpv shows: 0 hides everything, 3 shows the most.
SettingsHelpImageDisplayDuration: How long each image stays on screen in slideshow/directory mode, in seconds.
SettingsHelpOverrideDisplayFps: Assume the display runs at this frame rate instead of querying it. 0 disables the override. Useful with display-resample sync modes. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpCachePause: Pause playback while the network cache is filling. Disable to keep playing while buffering.
SettingsHelpPrefetchPlaylist: Start loading the next playlist entry while the current one still plays.
SettingsHelpSubAlignX: Horizontal position of subtitles: left, center or right.
SettingsHelpSubAlignY: Vertical position of subtitles: top, center or bottom.
SettingsHelpSubMarginX: Horizontal distance of subtitles from the screen edge, in pixels.
SettingsHelpSubMarginY: Vertical distance of subtitles from the screen edge, in pixels.
SettingsHelpOsdAlignX: Horizontal position of OSD text: left, center or right.
SettingsHelpOsdAlignY: Vertical position of OSD text: top, center or bottom.
SettingsHelpOsdMarginX: Horizontal distance of OSD text from the screen edge, in pixels.
SettingsHelpOsdMarginY: Vertical distance of OSD text from the screen edge, in pixels.
SettingsHelpDemuxerHysteresisSecs: Seconds the demuxer must exceed a cache range before switching back. 0 uses mpv's default.
SettingsHelpDemuxerCacheDir: Folder for the on-disk demuxer cache. Leave empty to let mpv decide.
SettingsHelpD3d11ExclusiveFs: Use exclusive fullscreen with the D3D11 renderer (lower input latency; may black-screen on some setups).
SettingsHelpD3d11Flip: Use flip-model presentation for D3D11 (best choice; disable only for fullscreen stutter/freezes).
SettingsHelpTargetColorspaceHintStrict: Strictly obey the target color space instead of adapting the source gamut.
SettingsHelpOsdFontSize: Font size of on-screen messages, relative to the screen height.
SettingsHelpOsdBarWidth: Width of the seek/volume progress bar, as a percentage of the screen.
SettingsHelpOsdBarHeight: Height of the seek/volume progress bar, as a percentage of the screen.
SettingsHelpOsdBlur: Gaussian blur applied to OSD text (0 disables).
SettingsHelpOsdFractions: Show time values with millisecond precision.
SettingsHelpAudioChannels: Speaker layout sent to the audio device; Auto (safe) falls back to a supported layout.
SettingsHelpAudioPitchCorrection: Keep the pitch when playback speed changes (otherwise speed-up raises the pitch).
SettingsHelpAudioNormalizeDownmix: Normalize the downmixed audio when playing multichannel audio on stereo.
SettingsHelpAudioFileAuto: Automatically load a matching external audio file next to the video.
SettingsHelpCoverArtImageExts: Image extensions treated as cover art, separated by semicolons.
SettingsHelpKeepOpen: Keep the window open after the playlist ends instead of quitting.
SettingsHelpWindowPiPSize: Size of the floating mini-player window.
SettingsHelpSavePositionOnQuit: Remember the playback position when quitting so the file can resume later.
SettingsHelpSpeed: Playback speed saved for the next launch (1.0 is normal).
SettingsHelpCacheEnabled: Network cache: Off disables, Auto caches only when needed, Yes always caches.
SettingsHelpDirectoryMode: How subfolders are handled when opening a directory: lazy adds on demand, recursive adds everything.
SettingsHelpImageExts: Extensions treated as images for playlists, separated by commas.
SettingsHelpAudioExts: Extensions treated as audio files for playlists, separated by commas.
SettingsHelpUiFont: Font used for the app's menus and interface.
SettingsHelpTestSignal: Play a test signal for debugging audio output.
SettingsHelpAlwaysOnTop: Keep the player window above other windows.
SettingsHelpInputIme: Enable the Windows input method editor for text fields.
SettingsHelpScreenshotJpegSourceChroma: Use the source video's chroma subsampling in JPEG screenshots.
SettingsHelpScreenshotPngFilter: PNG compression filter preset (0 none, 5 best compression).
SettingsHelpScreenshotWebpCompression: WebP compression level (0-6); higher compresses better but is slower.
SettingsHelpScreenshotJxlEffort: JPEG XL encode effort (1-9); higher is slower but smaller.
SettingsHelpScreenshotAvifEncoder: AV1 encoder used for AVIF screenshots.
SettingsHelpScreenshotTagColorspace: Tag the screenshot with the correct color space when the format supports it.
SettingsHelpSubDelay: Shift subtitles earlier or later, in seconds.
SettingsHelpSubPos: Vertical subtitle position: 100 is the bottom edge, 0 the top edge.
SettingsHelpAudioLanguage: Preferred language for audio tracks; Auto matches the system language.
SettingsHelpSubtitleLanguage: Preferred language for subtitle tracks; Auto matches the system language.
SettingsHelpImageSubsVideoResolution: Use the video resolution for image subtitles instead of the stored resolution.
SettingsHelpSubScaleSigns: Scale symbols and signs in subtitles with the font.
SettingsHelpSubAssVideoAspectOverride: Override the video aspect ratio reported to libass for ASS rendering.
SettingsHelpSubAuto: Automatically load a matching external subtitle file next to the video.
SettingsHelpSubCodePage: Character encoding of text subtitle files; Auto detects it.
SettingsHelpSubShadowOffset: Offset of the subtitle shadow, in pixels.
SettingsHelpDeinterlace: Deinterlace interlaced video: Auto detects, Yes always, No never.
SettingsHelpAspectRatio: Force a display aspect ratio; Auto keeps the video's own ratio.
SettingsHelpCorrectDownscaling: Use higher-quality color conversion when shrinking video.
SettingsHelpDither: Dithering algorithm for color depth conversion.
SettingsHelpDitherDepth: Target bit depth for dithered output; Auto matches the video.
SettingsHelpBackgroundTileColor0: First checkerboard color shown behind letterboxed/transparent video areas.
SettingsHelpBackgroundTileColor1: Second checkerboard color shown behind letterboxed/transparent video areas.
SettingsHelpBackgroundTileSize: Pixel size of each checkerboard square shown behind the video.
SettingsHelpSubFont: Font family name used for subtitles. Leave empty for the default font.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdEnableForAudio: Show the metadata overlay for audio files.
SettingsMetadataOsdEnableForAudioWithAlb: Show metadata OSD for album art audio
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdEnableForAudioWit: Show the metadata overlay for audio files displayed with album art.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdAutohideForAudio: Automatically hide the metadata overlay after the timeout for audio files.
SettingsMetadataOsdAutohideForAudioWithA: Auto-hide metadata OSD for album art audio
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdAutohideForAudioW: Automatically hide the metadata overlay after the timeout for audio files displayed with album art.
SettingsHelpHdrOverrideMode: Manually override the app's display HDR detection: leave Auto to follow the app, or force HDR/SDR output. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpTheme: Choose the color theme. Auto follows the Windows app mode and does not copy the accent color.
SettingsHelpBackdrop: Background material of the main window. Both Mica and Acrylic support a custom tint in Custom theme mode.
SettingsHelpDebugLog: Write debug logs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\mpv-winui\logs. Useful when reporting issues.
SettingsHelpLanguage: Language of the settings UI, menu bar and right-click menus. Applies immediately.
SettingsHelpHwdec: Hardware decoding API. Auto is recommended; Off uses software decoding (some video filters only work reliably in software).
SettingsHelpVolumeMax: Upper limit of the volume control (%). Values above 100 allow amplifier-style boost.
SettingsHelpVideoPreview: Show video preview thumbnails when hovering the progress bar.
SettingsHelpCacheSecs: Maximum seconds of network data kept in memory. 0 disables the limit.
SettingsHelpVideoSync: How playback is synchronized to the display refresh rate.
SettingsHelpScale: Upscaling algorithm used when the video is larger than the window. Lanczos or EWA Lanczos is recommended for quality/speed balance.
SettingsHelpDScale: Downscaling algorithm used when the video is smaller than the window. Bicubic is the default; Lanczos is sharper for strong downscaling.
SettingsHelpLinearDownscaling: Use linear light for downscaling to improve color accuracy.
SettingsHelpSigmoidUpscaling: Apply a sigmoid curve before upscaling to reduce ringing.
SettingsHelpToneMapping: Algorithm used to map HDR content to SDR. BT.2390 is recommended; Clip preserves details but cuts highlights.
SettingsHelpHrSeek: High-resolution seeking. On can be slower but more accurate.
SettingsHelpAudioDevice: Audio output device name returned by mpv (e.g. auto or wasapi/...).
SettingsHelpAudioDelay: Audio delay in seconds. Negative values make audio earlier.
SettingsHelpAudioExclusive: WASAPI exclusive mode. Can reduce latency but blocks other apps from the device.
SettingsHelpSubAssOverride: How strongly ASS/SSA subtitle styles are overridden. Scale (recommended) keeps layout; Strip removes styles and Force may break styled effects.
SettingsHelpSubEmbeddedFonts: Use fonts embedded in the media container (e.g. MKV).
SettingsHelpSubUseMargins: Render text subtitles in the black margins when available.
SettingsHelpScreenshotTemplate: Filename template. %F filename, %P time, %n counter, %w/%h size, %f format.
SettingsHelpScreenshotPngCompression: PNG compression level (0-9). Higher saves space but costs time.
SettingsHelpScreenshotHighBitDepth: Preserve high bit depth in screenshots. Can produce very large files.
SettingsHelpCacheOnDisk: Buffer network streams to disk while playing, so seeking back does not re-download.
SettingsHelpVideoOutputLevels: Signal range sent to the display. Limited is TV range, Full is PC range.
SettingsHelpIccProfileAuto: Load the display's ICC profile automatically for color calibration.
SettingsHelpIcc3dlutSize: Size of the 3D LUT generated from the ICC profile. Larger is more accurate but slower.
SettingsHelpAudioDisplay: What to show while playing audio: embedded cover art, external cover art, or nothing.
SettingsHelpSubFallback: What mpv does when no subtitle track matches the preferred language.
SettingsHelpBlendSubtitles: Draw subtitles into the video frame instead of overlaying them. Video limits subtitles to the visible picture.
SettingsHelpSubAssScaleWithWindow: Scale ASS subtitles with the window size instead of the video size.
SettingsHelpOsdDuration: How long on-screen messages stay visible (milliseconds).
SettingsHelpVsrAuto: Automatically upscale low-resolution video with NVIDIA VSR when the GPU supports it. Recommended on NVIDIA GPUs; works with RTX Video HDR and is suspended while other filters are active.
SettingsHelpSeekHold: Keep the window size fixed while seeking so filter reattachment does not resize the window.
WarningInterpolationVideoSync: Only effective with the "Resample to display refresh" video sync mode.
WarningHrSeekFramedrop: Not recommended while frame interpolation is enabled; disable it to keep interpolation accurate.
WarningDebandHwdec: May be ineffective with hardware decoding; switch hardware decoding to Off for guaranteed effect.
WarningSaveWithoutResume: Playback resume is disabled, so saved positions will not be restored.
WarningBlendSubtitlesMargins: Ignored while subtitles are blended into the video frame.
WarningSubFallbackNoLanguage: No preferred subtitle language is set, so fallback has no effect.
WarningSeekHoldInactive: Both auto VSR and RTX Video HDR are off; this option has no effect.
SettingsHelpHrSeekFramedrop: Allow dropping video frames while seeking for faster response.
SettingsHelpResumePlayback: Restore the last playback position on startup.
SettingsHelpSubFontProvider: Font provider used for subtitle fonts. Auto is recommended; Fontconfig enables system font fallback.
SettingsHelpSubAssForceMargins: Force ASS subtitles into the black margins when available.
SettingsHelpStretchImageSubsToScreen: Stretch image subtitles (e.g. PGS) to the screen resolution so they can render in the black margins.
SettingsHelpOsdFont: Font used for on-screen messages. Defaults to the system font.
SettingsHelpOsdOnSeek: What to show while seeking: progress bar, message, both, or nothing. Message is recommended.
SettingsHelpScreenshotSw: Capture screenshots through the software path. More compatible with some GPUs, but slower.
SettingsHelpVideoDecodeDirect: Decode video frames directly into GPU memory to reduce copies. Auto is recommended; set to Off if you see glitches with some drivers.
SettingsHelpDemuxerMaxBytes: How much data the demuxer keeps buffered for each stream. Larger values improve seeking back on network files but use more memory (default 150 MiB, recommended 1024 MiB).
SettingsHelpWatchLaterDir: Folder where mpv stores resume files. Leave empty for the built-in default.
SettingsHelpIccCacheDir: Folder for cached ICC profile to 3D LUT conversions. Leave empty for the built-in default.
SettingsHelpGpuShaderCacheDir: Folder for compiled GLSL shader caches. Leave empty for the built-in default.
SettingsHelpDemuxerReadahead: Seconds of data the demuxer reads ahead. Larger values help network streams but use more memory.
SettingsHelpYtdl: Resolve online video URLs (YouTube, Bilibili, etc.) with yt-dlp before playback. Requires yt-dlp to be installed.
SettingsHelpAutoCreatePlaylist: Automatically add files from the same folder to the playlist when opening a file.
SettingsHelpTscale: Temporal interpolation algorithm used when frame interpolation is enabled.
SettingsHelpLinearUpscaling: Upscale in linear light for better color accuracy. Not compatible with sigmoid upscaling.
SettingsHelpPanscan: Crop/zoom amount used to fill the screen and remove black bars (0-1).
SettingsHelpSubFilePaths: Extra folders searched for matching external subtitle files, separated by semicolons.
SettingsHelpSubHdrPeak: Peak white brightness of text subtitles when the output is HDR. SDR equals about 203 nits.
SettingsHelpImageSubsHdrPeak: Peak white brightness of image subtitles (PGS etc.) when the output is HDR.
SettingsHelpSubAssStyleOverrides: Override ASS style values, e.g. Fontname=Microsoft YaHei. Leave empty to keep file styles.
SettingsHelpOsdPlayingMsg: Message shown on the OSD when a file starts playing. Supports ${filename} etc.
SettingsHelpOsdPlayingMsgDuration: How long the playback-start message stays visible (milliseconds). 0 uses the global OSD duration.
SettingsHelpTargetColorspaceHint: Automatically switch the output colorspace to match the source. Recommended for HDR pass-through.
SettingsHelpTargetPrim: Primaries of the output colorspace when not using an ICC profile. Auto keeps the display profile.
SettingsHelpTargetTrc: Transfer curve of the output when not using an ICC profile. Auto keeps the display profile.
SettingsHelpTargetPeak: Advanced: manual tone-mapping target brightness in nits. 0 follows the detected display peak (see Display peak brightness).
SettingsHelpDisplayPeak: Peak brightness of your display in nits. 0 auto-detects from the monitor (fallback 1000). Drives HDR detection and is the default tone-mapping target unless Target peak brightness is set.
SettingsHelpIccCache: Cache ICC profile to 3D LUT conversions on disk.
SettingsHelpGpuShaderCache: Cache compiled GLSL shaders on disk to speed up startup.
SettingsHelpDemuxerMaxBackBytes: How much data the demuxer keeps buffered behind the current position. 0 disables the limit.
SettingsHelpHdrAutoLog: Write RTX Video HDR diagnostics to hdr_auto.log. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdEnabled: Show the metadata OSD (artist, album, title) when playback starts. No metadata OSD is shown when disabled. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdAutohideTimeout: Seconds before the metadata OSD hides automatically.
SettingsHelpCoverArtPreferEmbedded: Prefer the embedded cover-art track over an external cover image file.
SettingsHelpCscale: Chroma upscaling algorithm used for subsampled color channels.
WarningTscaleInterpolation: Only effective while frame interpolation is enabled.
WarningLinearUpscalingSigmoid: Linear light upscaling is enabled; the two options are mutually exclusive.
SettingsCoverArtAlwaysScan: Scan cover art for any file
SettingsHelpHwdecCodecs: Codecs that may use hardware decoding. All tries every codec; set a comma list such as h264,hevc to limit it.
SettingsHelpD3d11OutputCsp: Colorspace sent to the display in D3D11 mode. Auto keeps the SDR/WCG/HDR profiles.
SettingsHelpTargetColorspaceHintMode: Metadata used for the automatic colorspace hint: target, source, or source-dynamic.
SettingsHelpGamutMappingMode: How out-of-gamut colors are handled when tone mapping. Clip keeps details but cuts highlights.
SettingsHelpSubColor: Text subtitle color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Leave empty for the file default.
SettingsHelpAudioFilePaths: Extra folders searched for matching external audio files, separated by semicolons.
SettingsHelpVideoSyncMaxVideoChange: Maximum video rate change allowed when resampling; larger values smooth more but can distort audio.
SettingsHelpScreenshotJxlDistance: JXL visual distance: 0 is lossless, higher values compress more.
SettingsHelpWatchLaterOptions: Comma-separated properties saved with the playback position, e.g. start,vid,aid,sid.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdShowChapter: Show the current chapter number in the metadata OSD. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpCoverArtAlwaysScan: Scan for cover art for any file type, not only audio files. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpAudioWaitOpen: How long mpv waits for audio output to open, in seconds. 0 uses mpv's default; usually only useful together with audio-stream-silence=yes.
SettingsHelpIccProfile: Load a specific ICC profile file. Leave empty to keep auto color management.
SettingsHelpIccForceContrast: Force the ICC static contrast (nits). 0 disables it; OLED users often use 1000000.
SettingsHelpVideoUnscaled: Render the video at its original pixel size instead of scaling it to the window.
SettingsHelpSubAssUseVideoData: Video stream information passed to libass. All matches VSFilter behavior.
SettingsHelpSubAssVsfilterColorCompat: How ASS subtitle colors are converted for compatibility with VSFilter.
SettingsHelpAudioGapless: Keep the audio output open between files for gapless playback; Weak only keeps it between audio files.
SettingsHelpYtdlRawOptionsAppend: Extra options passed to yt-dlp, e.g. sub-langs=-danmaku.
SettingsHelpInputIpcServer: Named pipe for external programs to control mpv. Leave empty to disable.
SettingsHelpDirectoryFilterTypes: File types collected for the playlist when a folder is opened: video,audio,image,archive,playlist.
SettingsHelpVideoExts: Video extensions recognized when collecting playlist files, comma-separated.
SettingsHelpD3d11Adapter: GPU adapter used in D3D11 mode, e.g. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti Super. Empty keeps the system default.
SettingsHelpGlslShadersAppend: Additional GLSL shader files loaded at startup, separated by semicolons.
SettingsCommandPlaceholder: Type an mpv command, e.g. set volume 60
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdEnableForVideo: Show the metadata OSD for video files too. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdEnableForImage: Show the metadata OSD for image files too. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdAutohideStatusTim: Seconds before the status OSD hides automatically. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdShowAlbumTrack: Show the album track number in the metadata OSD. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpCoverArtLoadFromFilesystem: Search the filesystem for cover art files. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpCoverArtPreload: Load cover art before playback starts. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpMetadataOsdMessageMaxLength: Maximum length of metadata OSD messages in characters. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpCoverArtNames: Cover art filenames to look for, separated by semicolons. Takes effect on the next start.
SettingsHelpAudioBuffer: Audio output buffer in seconds (0-10). 0 lets mpv choose (0.2 by default); larger reduces glitches but adds latency.
SettingsHelpSubFontFile: Pick a folder; mpv scans it for extra subtitle fonts (sub-fonts-dir), then choose the family in Subtitle font.
SettingsHelpThemeAccentColor: Tint color for the backdrop material. Used by the Custom theme; the other themes follow the system accent automatically.
SettingsHelpThemeOpacity: How transparent the window backdrop material is (100 = fully transparent).
SettingsHelpThemeLuminosity: Strength of a white/black layer laid over the backdrop: 50 is neutral, higher brightens toward solid white, lower darkens toward solid black.
SettingsHelpShowOsdPlayingMsg: Show a message on the OSD when a file starts playing. Off hides it.
SettingsHelpTestMpvCommandLog: Write every command sent to mpv to the app log for troubleshooting.
SettingsHelpTestOsdMessage: Turn on to display a test OSD message; it resets immediately.
SettingsResetConfirm: Reset the settings on this page to their defaults?
SettingsResetAllConfirm: Reset all settings to their defaults? This cannot be undone.
SettingsHelpPiP: Switch the window to a compact always-on-top mini player.
SettingsHelpPiPAspectRatioLock: Keep the video aspect ratio while resizing the mini player. Turn off to stretch it freely.
SettingsHelpPiPAnchor: Screen corner the mini player claims when it opens.
SettingsHelpStartMaximized: Open the window maximized on launch.
SettingsHelpRememberWindowSize: Save the window size and position on exit and restore them on the next launch.
SettingsHelpUnassociateFiles: Remove the media file associations registered by this player.
SettingsHelpExportConfig: Save all settings to a settings file.
SettingsHelpImportConfig: Restore settings from a settings file.
SettingsConfigImported: Settings imported. Some options take effect on the next launch.
ResetShortcutsDone: Shortcuts reset. Takes effect on the next launch.
SettingsHelpYtdlFormat: Format string passed to yt-dlp, e.g. bestvideo+bestaudio/best, mp4, webm. Leave empty for yt-dlp defaults.
SettingsHelpYtdlPath: Path(s) to yt-dlp (semicolon separated). Leave empty to search PATH.
SettingsHelpYtdlTryFirst: Parse URLs with yt-dlp before letting mpv open them directly.
SettingsHelpYtdlAllFormats: Add every format reported by yt-dlp as a switchable track.
SettingsHelpYtdlUseManifests: Use the master manifest URL when available so audio/video can be switched at runtime.
SettingsHelpYtdlThumbnails: Add video thumbnails as tracks: none, best, or all.
SettingsHelpYtdlExclude: URL patterns that should not be sent to yt-dlp, separated by |.
SettingsHelpUserAgent: User agent used for HTTP streaming. Leave empty for the default.
SettingsHelpReferrer: Referrer path or URL for HTTP requests. Leave empty to send none.
SettingsHelpHttpHeaderFields: Comma-separated HTTP header fields, e.g. 'Field1: value1','Field2: value2'.
SettingsHelpHttpProxy: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL. Must start with http://; not used for https URLs.
SettingsHelpCookiesFile: Netscape-format cookies file for sites that require login.
SettingsHelpTlsVerify: Verify HTTPS peer certificates. Only disable for known-good reasons such as corporate proxies.
SettingsHelpNetworkTimeout: Network request timeout in seconds; 0 uses FFmpeg defaults (default 60).
SettingsHelpCurlMaxRedirects: Maximum HTTP redirects to follow before reporting an error (default 16).
SettingsHelpCurlMaxRetries: Transparent retry count for seekable transfers after recoverable errors (default 5).
SettingsHelpCurlConnectTimeout: TCP/TLS connect timeout; 0 uses libcurl defaults (default 30).
SettingsHelpCurlBufferSize: Producer-side ring buffer size that decouples the network thread (default 4 MiB).
SettingsHelpCurlMaxRequestSize: Split seekable transfers into range requests of at most this size; 0 keeps one request.
SettingsHelpFileAssociations: Choose which formats should open with this player. Changes apply immediately.
SettingsHelpControlBarLayout: Choose a control bar style: original or centered. Click Customize to drag-reorder or hide icons, or use + to add them.
WatchHistoryClearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear the history?
SettingsCheckForUpdatesDescription: Check the GitHub releases page for a newer version at startup.
SettingsControlBarCanvasHint: Drag the icons to reorder; drag off the bar to hide. The transport buttons are fixed.
SettingsHelpLoopPlaylist: Repeat the playlist after the last file (Off / infinite / force).
SettingsHelpSubScaleByWindow: Scale subtitle text together with the video window.
SettingsHelpSubLineSpacing: Extra spacing between subtitle lines (can be negative).
SettingsHelpSubJustify: Horizontal alignment of subtitle text: auto, left, center or right.
SettingsHelpSubClearOnSeek: Hide text subtitles while seeking (older subtitle libraries may misbehave).
SettingsHelpStartFullscreen: Enter fullscreen immediately when the player starts.
SettingsHelpAudioFormat: Sample format used for audio output (Auto = leave mpv's default).
SettingsHelpAudioSampleRate: Sample rate in Hz for audio output; 0 keeps mpv's default.
SettingsHelpAudioStreamSilence: Fill silent frames when there is no audio data (helps exclusive-mode output).
SettingsHelpD3d11OutputFormat: Pixel format of the D3D11 swap chain (Auto = recommended).
SettingsHelpD3d11SyncInterval: VBlank intervals between presented frames; 1 = vsync, 0 = off.
SettingsHelpTargetGamut: Limit the output gamut to a named colorspace (e.g. bt.709, bt.2020). Empty keeps the source metadata.
SettingsHelpToneMappingMaxBoost: Upper limit for brightness boosting during tone mapping (higher reveals dark details, may look unnatural).
SettingsHelpHdrComputePeak: Compute HDR peak brightness per frame instead of using tagged metadata (auto / on / off).
SettingsHelpHdrPeakDecayRate: Decay rate of the HDR peak detector (only when computing the peak).
SettingsHelpHdrSceneThresholdLow: Lower scene-change threshold in dB for the HDR peak detector.
SettingsHelpHdrSceneThresholdHigh: Upper scene-change threshold in dB for the HDR peak detector.
SettingsHelpHdrContrastRecovery: Restore contrast of HDR video after tone mapping (0 = off, 1 = 100%).
SettingsHelpHdrContrastSmoothness: Low-pass amount for HDR contrast recovery; lower on small/low-DPI displays.
SettingsHelpCachePauseInitial: Enter buffering before starting playback to prefetch network data.
SettingsHelpCachePauseWait: Seconds of buffered data required before playback resumes after a stall.
SettingsHelpInverseToneMapping: Expand dynamic range (SDR to HDR); not supported by all tone mapping curves. Use with caution.
SettingsHelpToneMappingVisualize: Display the active tone-mapping LUT graph for debugging.
SettingsHelpD3d11Warp: Render with the software WARP adapter instead of the GPU.
SettingsHelpVideoReversalBuffer: Approximate max bytes buffered for backward decoding; raise if reversal queue overflows.
SettingsHelpAudioReversalBuffer: Approximate max bytes buffered for backward decoding of audio.
SettingsHelpGlslShaders: GLSL shader list applied to the player; disabled entries are kept but not applied. Use the arrows to reorder.
SettingsHelpGlslShaderOpts: Parameters for tunable shader values as key=value pairs, comma-separated (e.g. shader/param=value).
SettingsHelpWindowTitle: Override the window title. Empty uses the media title.
SettingsHelpSubHinting: Font hinting for subtitle text: none, light, normal or native (may misposition text).
